items.label: Strong and High-quality Living Room Chairs
items.value: Our lazy chair with ottoman is made of sturdy rust-proof pipe steel frame and soft PP cotton. This makes our lounge chair can be used for a long time without rust and has a longer service life. Heavy-duty steel pipes can prevent chair from deformation or dent. This comfy chairs for living room can hold up to 400 pounds. Besides, We have designed a protective padded cushion under the chair to reduce a certain amount of wear.

items.label: Comfy Accent Chairs with Ottoman
items.value: Our modern lounge accent chair with armrests and a side pocket which can hold your mobile phone, newspapers, books, etc. and it comes with a footrest on which you can rest your legs for an extremely comfortable seating experience which brings convenience to everyone. Furthermore, the footrest serves a dual purpose by also functioning as an extra stool for additional seating when required. When not in use, ottoman can be easily folded up for convenient storage.

items.label: Spacious Size of Velvet Fabric Armchair with Ottoman
items.value: 28.5"L x 25.5"W x 37.4"H. This size can easily accommodate an adult. It is big enough to have enough space to relax and stretch and enjoy full relaxation. Moreover, the comfortable headrest provides excellent support for your head.

items.label: Easy to Assemble Accent Chairs
items.value: The leisure chair has a simple structure, following the detailed and illustrated manual guidance, just need to put several parts together, requiring no screws or nuts. And the straps on the inside of the cover can be tied around the legs of the accent chair for a better hold.

items.label: Versatile Use of Recliners for Small Spaces
items.value: Add a fun, cozy touch to living room, bedroom, or balcony, dorm rooms, lofts, reading nooks and more with this comfy seat. Also it can provide a convenient place for friends or family to sit with this ultra-cozy and comfy sofa chair. The lounge chair isn’t just for adults to relax in - it’s great lazy chair for kids and teens. You can even put your pet on a chair to accompany you.

items.label: Cleaning Instructions
items.value: The seat cushion can be hand-washed or machine-washed. Once the cushion is completely dry, it should be fluffed and then reinstalled onto the chair. Plus, Our lazy chair comes with a 3-year quality guarantee. If you have any product-related inquiries, please reach out to us, and we'll respond within 12 hours to assist you until the issue is resolved.

items.value: Easy to assemble with detailed, illustrated manual guidance.
